primary-ink.$description: Primary Ink — Headlines, body text, button labels — the dominant foreground tone across all surfaces; Hero product image background — fades from solid #1d1d1f at top into chromatic blue

mid-gray.$description: Mid Gray — Secondary text, nav inactive state, muted UI labels

deep-gray.$description: Deep Gray — Navigation text and iconography at medium emphasis

hairline.$description: Hairline — Hairline borders between sections and UI elements

canvas.$description: Canvas — Alternating section backgrounds — the gray band that breaks up white sections

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, primary page background, button text on dark fills

cool-wash.$description: Cool Wash — Subtle button backgrounds, hovered surfaces, pagination dot fills

faded-surface.$description: Faded Surface — Global nav opened state, elevated panel surfaces

quiet-dot.$description: Quiet Dot — Pagination indicator fills, tertiary interactive state

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Filled action buttons — the only chromatic accent in the UI, used sparingly for CTAs

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Inline body text links, arrow-link chevron text

ember.$description: Ember — Orange state accent for badges, validation surfaces, and short status labels.

sky.$description: Sky — Product finish swatch — pastel blue surface option

citrus.$description: Citrus — Product finish swatch — pastel yellow-green surface option

starlight.$description: Starlight — Product finish swatch — warm cream surface option

silver.$description: Silver — Product finish swatch — cool gray surface option

blush.$description: Blush — Product finish swatch — soft pink surface option

indigo.$description: Indigo — Product finish swatch — muted indigo surface option

midnight.$description: Midnight — Product finish swatch — deep charcoal surface option

citrus-gradient.$description: Citrus Gradient — Product hero alternative finish — dark base fading through yellow-green highlight

sf-pro-display.$description: Section headings, card titles, subheadings — weight 600 with slightly positive tracking reads as warm and approachable at mid sizes, contrasting the tight display headlines above

sf-pro-text.$description: Body copy, navigation, supporting paragraphs, small labels — weight 400 at 17px is the workhorse. Negative tracking tightens the body for crispness on dense informational pages
